text:
Europe/Paris in 1740 likely used local mean time, but for this exercise we’ll assume its UTC offset is the same as modern standard time for Europe/Paris (UTC+1) unless otherwise noted.  
Asia/Singapore modern standard time is UTC+8.  
Target time = 01:00 + (8 − 1) = 01:00 + 7 = 08:00 same day.  
No date change in this simple wrap-around arithmetic.  

FINAL_ANSWER: July 1, 1740 08:00
